name: agent-coder
description: Implementation subagents for bounded code changes, tests, and refactors within a defined scope. Ships `coder` (edits the caller's tree directly; the parent commits) and `parallel-coder` (runs in an isolated worktree, self-commits, and hands back a reviewable branch — for parallel or staged work). Claude also gets a top-level edit reminder; Codex relies on steering because tool-hook payloads do not identify subagent edits.
